scenes.title: Vinte passos a leste (Twenty Paces East)
scenes.summary: Outside the courtyard gate on {STREET}, F1, M2, and M3 check the brass compass and count twenty paces east toward the stone fountain.

scenes.title: Perto do chafariz de pedra (By the Stone Fountain)
scenes.summary: At the neighbourhood stone fountain, F1 and M3 spot a carved leaf pointing toward the clock tower, but M2 insists on taking a back-lane shortcut.

scenes.title: O famoso atalho (The Famous Shortcut)
scenes.summary: After three confident left turns, M2 leads the group straight back outside F2's open café kitchen window at {SHOW}.

scenes.title: A sombra da torre do relógio (Shadow of the Clock Tower)
scenes.summary: Joined by M4 at the municipal clock tower at noon, F1 and M3 watch the tower shadow point straight to a carved compass stone.

scenes.title: Debaixo do arco do sebo (Under the Bookshop Arch)
scenes.summary: Meeting F3 under the stone arch of the second-hand bookshop, F1 spots the green lending shelf in Card Three—making F3 gasp as she remembers the botanical book in Room 4.

scenes.title: O banco sombreado da praça (The Shaded Park Bench)
scenes.summary: At the shaded public garden bench at the end of {STREET}, M3 places all four square cards together to reveal a bird's-eye map of {SHOW} with a red star on the upper balcony.

scenes.title: Abrindo o envelope pequeno (Opening the Small Envelope)
scenes.summary: On the park bench, F1, F3, and M3 break the wax seal and read the mapmaker's promise to return for Saturday tea thirty summers later.

scenes.title: Recado na recepção (Message at the Front Desk)
scenes.summary: Returning briskly to the front desk, F1 and M2 find M1 holding an express station message announcing the retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday evening.
